summary: Molecular Partners AG filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated July 6, 2026, providing a routine update on clinical progress for its pipeline of DARPin radiotherapeutics. The release describes ongoing Phase 1/2a dosing of MP0712 targeting DLL3 for small cell lung cancer, with initial data expected within months and comprehensive efficacy data in 2027. It also mentions compassionate care work using an actinium-225 variant and plans for a new target nomination in H2 2026 with two INDs in 2027. No financial terms, transactions, board recommendations, or special-situation events are disclosed; this is a standard business update that does not constitute a special situation as defined. The Form 6-K is the SEC equivalent of a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer.
